items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But then there’s some other people that I think he probably wouldn’t hire. Kenny Garrett. Because he seems to be getting far out. But I want to have Kenny Garrett.

ctx.x: I guess being a pianist I’ve noticed that. [laughs]
